decision_model.description: The shape of the value the candidate function returns. Cases in the authority-decision family use the four-valued model documented in docs/AUTHORITY_DECISION_MODEL.md; the others return a parse result, a validation error, a boolean fact, or a three-valued fact that feeds such a decision.

exposure.description: Contamination status. PUBLIC_PILOT_ONLY means the case, its reference, and its graders are public and have been read by the authoring models, so the case cannot serve as a clean confirmatory measurement.

mutants.description: Directory of committed near-miss and degenerate-strategy implementations. Every committed mutant must be killed by the case grader.
